params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user

params.name: sourceCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 currency in which all fees are quoted. Defaults to `USD`.

params.name: paymentMethod
params.description: Payment method to produce an estimate for. Presence of this field triggers the `estimate` block in the response and requires `destinationCurrency`.

params.name: destinationCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 payout currency — keys the specific corridor for the `estimate`. Required whenever `paymentMethod`, `destinationCountry`, or `sourceAmount` is supplied.

params.name: destinationCountry
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination country code. Use this when several countries share a currency (e.g. USD sent to Ecuador vs. USD sent to El Salvador) so the estimate resolves to the right country. Only meaningful when `destinationCurrency` is also supplied.

params.name: sourceAmount
params.description: Decimal payout amount used to resolve percentage-based fees into a concrete `estimate.fee.value`. Ignored for fixed-fee corridors. Requires `destinationCurrency`.

items.docs:
Retrieve the payout catalog for a user — fees, delivery timelines, and transfer limits per corridor.

`data.payouts` is the full, unfiltered catalog (the user's rate card) and is always returned.

Supply `paymentMethod` together with `destinationCurrency` to also receive `data.estimate` — a per-transaction fee, delivery timeline, and transfer limits for the specified corridor. Add `destinationCountry` when several countries share a currency (e.g. USD sent to Ecuador vs. USD sent to El Salvador)
